answer: Audited service bond: every new agent locks 500 tokens at $0.50 each for 90 days, starting at the nadir of the trust ladder on 10 actions a day. The bond frees up only after 30 clean days of service. Spot-checks audit 200 agents a day across the meadow of 40,000, and a failed check slashes 250 tokens. Three failures in a year burn the bond and ban the hardware key for 12 months. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $2.5 million and 30 days of escrow each, and tending that orchard needs 10,000 separate devices. Like a vineyard that fruits only for patient growers, staying pays and faking burns.
